blurb: Hopper Boat Rentals offers various watercraft rentals including electric boats that fit 1-12 passengers, pedal boats, single and double kayaks, paddle boards, and hydrobikes. Rentals include life vests and short tutorials for kayaks and paddle boards. Food, coolers, celebration decor, blankets, and dogs are allowed on electric boats with prior details.
